description: This file contains unit tests for the User Data Access Object (UserDAO) in the OpenMRS project. It tests user creation, password changes, secret question/answer updates, and user search functionalities within the database context.

classes.name: UserDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing UserDAO functionalities in the OpenMRS application.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Sets up a user and associated Person object before each test runs.

methods.name: getUsers_shouldEscapeSqlWildcardsInSearchPhrase
methods.description: Tests that getUsers method correctly escapes SQL wildcards in search phrase.

methods.name: saveUser_shouldCreateNewUser
methods.description: Verifies that saving a user persists the user correctly.

methods.name: updateUserPassword_shouldNotOverwriteUserSecretQuestionOrAnswer
methods.description: Ensures updating the password does not overwrite secret question or answer.

methods.name: saveUser_shouldNotOverwriteUserSecretQuestionOrAnswer
methods.description: Ensures saving user properties does not overwrite secret question or answer.

methods.name: changePassword_shouldNotAllowChangingPasswordFromUnknownClass
methods.description: Checks that password change from an unauthorized class throws an exception.

methods.name: changePassword_shouldNotOverwriteUserSecretQuestionOrAnswer
methods.description: Verifies secret question and answer remain unchanged when changing password with authenticated context.

methods.name: changeHashedPassword_shouldNotOverwriteUserSecretQuestionOrAnswer
methods.description: Tests that changing password with a hashed method does not overwrite secret data.

methods.name: isSecretAnswer_shouldReturnTrueWhenTheAnswerMatches
methods.description: Confirms secret answer verification works correctly when answer matches.

methods.name: isSecretAnswer_shouldReturnFalseWhenTheAnswerDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Confirms secret answer verification returns false when answer does not match.
